items.description: R4 — "Prove with a `terraform plan` showing **no destroys** before any hook runs for real." The runbook's plan of KubeCoderDeploy's `terraform/` against the new key, per stage, shows zero destroys and names the output expected. Per the review Q1 ruling it is one operator-typed command that loads the provider credentials through `bao-login.sh` and HelmCharts' `setup-env.sh prd` and runs the plan; the same command supplies the rest of the hook's environment that Terraform reads with no further OpenBao read, and keeps `TF_VAR_github_webhook_secret` a placeholder — Claude reads no OpenBao value. The hook image's terraform is checked not older than the one pushing the state before any push.

items.description: R5 — "Land KubeCoderDeploy; `helm template` renders clean with the library dependency." KubeCoderDeploy's render gate is green on what P1 and P2 leave, and the runbook replays HelmCharts' chart drift again just before each stage's diff review, gate green.

R6 — "One registry commit: `reconciler: argo-cd`, `deployed: true`, `autoSync: false`, plus `repo` and `targetRevision`; no `chart:` key is needed (A.3). Delete the stage's `values.yaml` (+ `_shared/` once both stages are over). The Jenkins pipeline fires on the path change and now *skips* the release (A.3) — Jenkins and Argo are never both live on it." `repo` is KubeCoderDeploy's clone URL, `targetRevision` `main` for dev and `prd` for prd. The runbook spells each stage's entry out in full, and `_shared/`'s deletion comes only after prd's state surgery, with the orphan audit's expected listing noted at that step.

items.description: R8 — "Review the Application's diff in the UI. Expected: the table closing the runbook's "Previewing a migrating app's diff before its cutover" — **anything else stops the cutover**." The table is re-derived if the chart moved: the pre-flight (argocd.md's "What a cutover does not change") runs after the chart re-sync and before the review; argocd.md's table and KubeCoder residue note match the chart as P1 leaves it (the five containers' `imagePullPolicy` now an expected change); the runbook says how prd's expected set is obtained, since the table was derived for dev.

items.description: R9 — "Sync once, manually, at the chosen moment. Verify Synced/Healthy, controller `1/1 Running`, ConfigMap correct, env pods back." The moment is the operator's; prd's sync and its checks can be done by the operator alone, with a named point to resume from.
R10 — "Flip `autoSync: true`." A registry commit per stage, after that stage's checks pass.
R11 — "Exercise the loop once on dev: image build → tags commit → webhook → auto-sync." The runbook gives the steps and what each link must show.

R12 — "prd additionally: promotion exercised once (`prd` advanced to the validated `main` SHA), and a rollback rehearsed (revert on `main`, promote — D36)." The rehearsal reverts a real pin commit and rolls forward, scheduled with the promotion exercise.

R13 — "Afterwards, unhurried: delete the orphaned `sh.helm.release.v1.kubecoder-<stage>.*` Secrets, `charts/kubecoder/` in HelmCharts, and the D145 overrides (B.2)." The runbook's post-cutover section covers both stages' Secrets and `charts/kubecoder/`, and specifies the KubeCoder task filed for after prd's cutover: the controller's worker and vsix ImageVolume `pullPolicy: "Always"` lines removed, and D145 updated from what is then live (partial retirement; the stale checklist corrected).

items.description: R14 — "`Build-Main`: tag `:<n>`/`:latest` (stage prefix dropped), call the method on `main` with both stage files — dev's pins at `<n>`, prd's at `prd-<n>`." and "`Deploy-PRD` is **deleted at the prd cutover** (D35), not before; the old path stays alive until each stage cuts over." — `Build-Main`'s rewrite at dev's cutover, `Deploy-PRD`'s replacement at prd's. The runbook specifies what `Build-Main` must do after each edit: push `:<n>`/`:latest` for all eight images and, between the two cutovers only, `:dev-<n>` as well; call `cicd.writeVersionPins(repo:, pins:, message:)` once per build with `<n>` for `config/dev/values.yaml` and `prd-<n>` for `config/prd/values.yaml` (the five `images.*` pins with their leading colon); declare `disableConcurrentBuilds()`; run the call in a container with `git`; deploy nothing. `Deploy-PRD` is deleted, and the `:dev-<n>` push stopped, only after the promote job has retagged.

items.description: KubeCoderDeploy carries a hand-triggered promote job (D2) that retags the seven images the promoted commit's `config/prd/values.yaml` names to their `prd-<n>` tags, then fast-forwards `prd` to that commit (creating `prd` on its first run), then writes and pushes D48's annotated `release-<m>` tag, `<m>` its own build number; it promotes `main`'s tip by default, refuses anything but a fast-forward, carries no rollback parameter, stops before moving `prd` if any retag fails, and holds registry and git credentials only.

/work/KubeCoderDeploy/config/prd/values.yaml — five images.* suffixes :prd-523, two controllerConfig.images whole references

items.description: The five pinned containers (controller, ingress, manual, bot, mcp) declare `imagePullPolicy: IfNotPresent` in both stages' renders, and KubeCoderDeploy's render gate fails a render that does not declare it; `tunnel-reclaim` keeps `Always`.
evidence: /work/KubeCoderDeploy/tests/render-chart.py:374 — today's check is only != "Always"

items.description: KubeCoderDeploy carries every change HelmCharts landed under `charts/kubecoder/` and `configs/prd/kubecoder/` since the recorded copy commit, keeps every Argo-specific difference its README lists, and records the new copy point.

The runbook states one sequence in which: the owed Argo self-sync is confirmed before dev's first sync; the rewritten `Build-Main` runs before dev's registry commit, so the first dev sync names a build that exists; per stage the registry commit precedes the state surgery; prd's registry commit waits on `prd` born (the promote job's first run) → KubeCoderDeploy's architecture producer green on it → its `pipeline-producers.yaml` registration.
"Dev stage end to end first. **Let it sit.** Then prd."

Every `terraform state rm`, `state mv`, `terraform plan`, `helm` invocation, Argo sync, registry commit and Jenkins job change in the runbook is the operator's keystroke or is pushed only on the operator's confirmation. Claude reads no OpenBao secret value at any step: where a step needs one — R4's plan loading its provider credentials (review Q1 ruling) — it is loaded inside the operator's own command, and the webhook secret stays a placeholder.
evidence: /work/Ansible/docs/live-infra-access.md:44-52 — the documented route for a Terraform plan needing OpenBao-held provider credentials: bao-login.sh and setup-env.sh loaded in the plan's own command

items.description: The runbook is its own file in `/work/Ansible/docs/runbooks/`, covers both stages, points into `argocd.md` for the diff table, the pre-flight and the architecture-producer steps rather than repeating them, and every stop condition names the state the stage is left in and the way back.

"**Exit:** both stages on Argo; a full build → dev → promote → prd cycle and one rollback done through git alone; Jenkins holds no cluster credential for KubeCoder." Owed to the operator; the runbook closes with the check that proves each part, the last read as: no Jenkins job deploys KubeCoder (`Build-Main` calls no `cicd.helmDeploy()`, `Deploy-PRD` is gone, HelmCharts refuses both stages, the promote job holds no cluster credential).
evidence: /work/JenkinsPipelineUtils/vars/cicd.groovy:1-3 — helmDeploy() builds IaC/HelmCharts, the shared deploy path
